The abstraction axes are not three spokes — one trunk, four crowns

Facts flow left↔right. Every fact (callback execution; CUDA API call) carries every attribute, so each crown is an aggregation cone away from the fine middle. The ROS chain joins the OS chain at N and shares everything below it; the CPU end forks into deployment (EX) vs design (ns) crowns, the GPU end forks into deployment (streams) vs design (kernel names).
